cases.target_task: A remote review request timed out after submission. Decide the first safe boundary before doing any further work.

facts: The request has a stable idempotency key.
The remote terminal outcome is currently unknown.
No later reconciliation receipt exists.

cases.treatment_query: safe continuation after ambiguous remote completion

cases.target_task: An observation says a build passed, but no verifier artifact is attached. Decide whether the task can be closed and name the first admissible check.

facts: The observation is candidate-only.
The acceptance contract requires a current verifier receipt.

cases.target_task: A freshly opened tool can reach its database directly, yet the agent namespace reports a closed initialization channel. Choose the cheapest discriminating probe.

facts: The native database health probe succeeds.
Only the resumed host namespace fails initialization.

cases.treatment_query: separate stale host transport state from healthy native service

reciprocal_flow.source_task: From the sealed native-service and host-namespace evidence, submit one novel candidate experience through ELIOT and return its candidate-only receipt.
reciprocal_flow.source_statement: A healthy native service plus a failing resumed host namespace localizes the defect to stale host transport or initialization state, so compare native health with the host channel before repairing the database.

cases.target_task: A UI surface vanished after an upstream patch while a sibling surface still renders correctly. Localize the first inspection boundary without assuming shared rendering is broken.

facts: The sibling surface still renders the same underlying data.
Only discovery of the patched surface is failing.

cases.treatment_query: working sibling narrows regression to discovery or hook surface

reciprocal_flow.source_task: From the sealed sibling-surface and patch evidence, submit one novel candidate experience through ELIOT and return its candidate-only receipt.
reciprocal_flow.source_statement: A working sibling surface plus one vanished patched surface localizes the regression to discovery or hook attachment, so compare their surface anchors before changing the shared renderer.

cases.target_task: A nontrivial Rust change is ready for closeout. Select the project-native verification sequence and state when the persistent code graph is refreshed.

facts: Source files changed materially.
The workspace exposes Justfile verification commands.

cases.treatment_query: Rust finish procedure verifier then persistent index refresh

cases.target_task: A previous recovery note recommends retrying immediately after a provider timeout. Current state still lacks a terminal receipt. Decide whether to reuse that note.

facts: Provider outcome remains unknown.
The old note predates idempotent reconciliation support.

cases.treatment_query: negative memory prevents unsafe retry under unknown outcome

cases.target_task: A remembered fix concerns a WebSocket authentication failure. The present error is a compiler feature-gate mismatch before any network process starts. Judge transferability.

facts: Compilation stops before runtime startup.
The failing symbol is behind a disabled Cargo feature.

cases.treatment_query: near miss between runtime auth failure and compile feature mismatch

cases.target_task: Historical memory names an old executable and endpoint, while current runtime publication records a different signed binary and generation. Select the authoritative state.

facts: Current runtime publication is authenticated and generation v2.
The historical path belongs to generation v1.

cases.treatment_query: current authenticated runtime overrides superseded path memory

cases.target_task: Choose the first inspection boundary for a newly introduced binary-format parser with no related prior cases in the project memory.

facts: The parser module is new.
No current verification result exists yet.

cases.treatment_query: new binary parser unrelated to retained experience

cases.target_task: A sleep cycle produced a promising consolidation candidate but no replay verdict. Decide how it may influence the next action.

facts: The sleep output is candidate-only.
Replay and holdout evidence are absent.

cases.treatment_query: sleep candidate remains non-authoritative before replay

cases.target_task: A once-correct workaround is explicitly suppressed after the underlying defect was fixed. A similar symptom appears again. Decide whether the workaround should be reinstated.

facts: The workaround has a current suppressed lifecycle transition.
The original defect is verified fixed.

cases.treatment_query: suppressed workaround must not regain admission from surface similarity

cases.target_task: A worker lease expired after producing an unverified diff. The bounded run still has budget. Choose the next controller action and evidence gate.

facts: The expired worker no longer has mutation authority.
The diff is candidate-only and has no verifier receipt.

cases.treatment_query: lease expiry recovery preserves candidate diff and reassigns verification
